postal_system.assignment_rule: IPOSTEL is the designated Venezuelan postal operator. The May 2019 UPU country sheet defines four digits: digit one is the postal region and digits two through four identify the delivery office. A valid string or UPU example is not current assignment evidence; retain only an authorized, time-bound IPOSTEL lookup observation with endpoint state, observed_at, retrieved_at and response digest.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Treat a full code as delivery-network-first. A delivery office, postal route, P.O. box or locality label is not automatically an area. A service-area polygon may be derived for review only from exact, rights-cleared, time-compatible IPOSTEL routing or area evidence. No reusable nationwide official postcode polygon release has been verified for this seed. UPU examples, INE localities, IGVSB or municipal boundaries, cadastral parcels, road buffers, interpolation, Voronoi cells and model outputs cannot be presented as official IPOSTEL postcode geometry or used to fill unknown coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, street, intersection or reference, house number, premises or building, entrance, floor, apartment or office, urbanization or sector or barrio, parish, municipality, locality, state or Capital District, P.O. box, postal office and four-digit postcode separately. UPU and operator examples are never production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as delivery_office, delivery_office_service_area, postal_region, locality, route, po_box, organization or unknown. Region digit, four-digit code, office, route, locality, parish, municipality and polygon must never be collapsed into one class.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, an explicit reviewed relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, edition, validity, privacy, CRS and digest. A postcode, locality, reference, populated-place point, cadastral parcel, coordinate, containment, interpolation or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Federal entity or Capital District, municipality, parish and populated-place identities are versioned administrative context. The dated INE 2001 populated-place nomenclator context is not a current territorial register, IPOSTEL assignment or postal polygon. Pin exact current authority, edition, jurisdiction, legal status, terms and digest before crosswalking.
postal_system.cartography_and_cadastre_rule: The national geography, cartography and cadastre law assigns national geographic functions to IGVSB and cadastral responsibilities across national and municipal authorities. A statute declaring territorial information public is not by itself a bulk-data licence, current dataset, parcel-to-address link or building relation. Every layer requires producer, edition, jurisdiction, access terms, CRS, quality and digest review.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Authorized IPOSTEL observations plus rights-cleared administrative, locality, road, address and building evidence may normalize input, validate joins, rank candidates, build review surfaces, simplify or compress geometry, detect drift and train or run review models. Every output preserves source version, input and artifact digests, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official-observation or derived-review status. A model never upgrades evidence, fills unknown coverage or invents an address, unit, building, person, owner, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound IPOSTEL observations, typed postal-network objects, reviewed derived service areas, permitted civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling any source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Venezuelan postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: A public IPOSTEL search page does not by itself grant bulk extraction, caching or redistribution rights. The UPU sheet is semantic evidence, not a bulk-data licence. Dated INE material and each IGVSB, municipal or cadastral artifact require exact producer, edition, access, privacy, reuse and digest review. ODbL content remains separately attributed and partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack is ISO VE scope but preserves each source jurisdiction, temporal validity, legal status and territorial representation independently. Postal, administrative, statistical, cadastral, address, building, disputed or claimed-area and AGID coverage must not be conflated, silently extended or used to resolve sovereignty.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, references, house numbers, entrances, units, coordinates, operator queries, cadastral records, owners, recipients, organizations, credentials and logs can expose household, property, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private, owner-linked and query data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: IPOSTEL assignments and observations, the May 2019 UPU sheet, the dated INE 2001 nomenclator context, IGVSB and municipal layers, legal and cadastral states, derived surfaces, building relations and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, service and artifact version, edition, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with source release, item terms, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. IPOSTEL query logs, real addresses, references, fine cadastral or building data, credentials, owner-linked data and restricted inputs stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery, a Space is demonstration and production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
